lines: We followed the mechanical spiders, trying not to lose sight of them, while fighting off wandering Zombies.
!! The little ones are picking up speed. We need to hurry!
Wh-What's with you all of a sudden, Fuma-chan!?
D-Don't scare me like that!!! I thought you had turned into a Zombie!!
No, I can't believe... I forgot to negotiate our payment!
Payment... Are you trying to get money from the Mask Lady? This is about justice and about doing good for the world.
Dumbass! We have to outrun other UFS organizations to get that virus from Gaiza!
It's an incomparably extra-dangerous mission. It's natural to demand payment.
But Fuma-chan. This is all started with Gaiza-chan, demanding compensation is just...
Listen here... It costs money to run our unit, or to do anything really.
Local fundraising is a legitimate right granted to any Taimanin unit.
I, as someone making do with my meager allowance, was naturally driven to persuade them.
Hey, hey, are you that obsessed with money, Fuma?
Hebiko is a little disappointed in you.
What are you arguing about? Payment? I already received that in advance. Including yours.
Akitsu handed over a bulging envelope. It was stuffed with bills. For an advance payment, it was quite a lot of money.
When the mission is over, Heberybody can go to a nice sushi restaurant to celebrate Hebiko's discharge from hospital! Right, Fuma-chan!!
In response to their astounding flip-flopping, I snatched the envelope back from them.
You guys don't need any money if it's in the name of justice for the world, right!? This is mine!!!
Hebiko and Shikanosuke reached for the envelope that I was holding up high.
...Appalling. Taimanin really are carefree ninja! Come on, the spiders are getting away!!
